channel.title: Workspace Overview on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Workspace Overview on KubeSphere

item.title: View Resource Usage
item.description: This section describes how to view workspace resource usage. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Workspace Settings View permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Workspace Settings View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Overview > Resource Usage in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Cluster Information
item.description: This section describes how to view the basic information of clusters authorized to the workspace. Prerequisites You need to join a workspace and have the Workspace Settings View permission in the workspace. For more information, see Workspace Members and Workspace Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Workspace Settings View permissions and enter your workspace. Click Overview > Cluster Information in the left navigation pane.
